decisions.reason: The dumper was only mentioned on the website, so little has been visibly committed to it and dropping it would cost little, but there is no evidence that its results have clearly failed, so it is kept for now.
The inclined furniture lift is a multi-model line with its own page and anchors the firm's new lift family, so dropping it would write off a visible investment.

The building material lift shares design and investment with the lift family and was presented on its own page, so any weak results are likely to be attributed to temporary causes such as the pandemic.

The truck-mounted variant has its own page and extends the committed lift family, which makes continuing it easier to justify than dropping it, although as a single model it is somewhat more expendable.
